notes: Explora is in Old Town Albuquerque.
name: Career Pathways Internship at X Studio
org: Explora Science Center and Children's Museum
what_you_do: A paid internship that lasts 2 years, for rising juniors and seniors who like STEAM jobs. You work 10 to 20 hours a week.
who_can_apply: Rising high school juniors interested in STEAM careers who can commit 10 to 20 hours a week.
duration: Two school years (junior and senior year), 10 to 20 hours a week
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran July 20 to Aug 26, 2026, interviews Aug 31 to Sept 5, onboarding Sept 19. 2027 dates not posted; expect summer.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Google Form. Ask a teacher, mentor or parent to send in a recommendation form.
